errors.evidence: The figure shows “语言文明” as the light/white slice, not “言语文明”. The machine description uses the wrong category name and color mapping.

The figure shows the 3% slice for “仪表文明” in orange; the description is broadly correct on the category but the color is more specifically orange rather than a distinct light orange. This is a minor color-mapping imprecision.
